name: Zhongyeda Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongyeda Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution of industrial electrical products in China. The company offers power equipment, systems, and transmission and distribution products; and automatic control systems and products, safety and environmental protection equipment, lighting and temperature control, and other systems and products.
